learning_outcomes.text: Student knows the principles of designing electrical installations in facilities for various purposes.
Student knows the principles of selecting components of electrical installations for their proper operation and for the expected levels of exposure to the hazards they are subject to.
Student can calculate characteristic electrical quantities determining the selection of electrical installation components under normal operation and during fault conditions.
Student can independently prepare project documentation and perform required drawings.
Student is ready to work in a group on project execution.

syllabus_topics: Designing electrical installations in residential premises.
Planning demand power and peak power.
Principles of selecting wires and installation protections.
Designing electrical installations in industrial facilities.
Receivers and power quality in industry.
Selection of wires and cables, protections and switching apparatus.
Selected computer programs supporting the design of electrical installations.
The essence of the design process.
The task involves making a design of an electrical installation for a selected industrial facility according to specific requirements indicated in the first part of the classes.
assessment_rules: Active participation in lecture discussions is required for lectures. For project classes, the handed-in electrical installation project and involvement in teamwork are assessed.
